info.title: Galung Phase 02 identity implementation contract
info.description: Identity-only review revision. Reconciles ODL-007 overlay with canonical draft; requires Security, Tech Lead and QA review before freeze. No commercial API is promoted.

acceptedTermsVersion.description: Must match server-published text version and logged content hash.

pdfDownloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL or controlled download endpoint.

accountNumber.description: Sensitive; only disclosed to authenticated owner via invoice, no logs or analytics.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL host outside API, never log; whitelisted upload destination.

bankCreditId.description: Required only for approval; must represent verified bank funds.

deviceProof.description: Signature over the approved canonical request, challenge and body hash.

signedToken.description: Compact JWS, device-bound and readable; no secret claims.

refreshCredential.description: Rotated opaque secret returned once; exact retry behavior in licensing protocol.

DevicePublicKeyJwk.description: Draft P-256 device proof key; Windows interoperability approval pending.

OfflineEntitlementClaims.description: Claims inside compact JWS with protected alg=EdDSA, typ=galung-offline+jwt and pinned kid. All times Unix seconds.

post.description: Account requires verified email before paid checkout. Verification event sent via outbox.
